title: Daily digest: Level 3 Elevated
message: No new attacks on US bases or tankers found in the last day; Hormuz is still shut and oil eased to about US$89. Elsewhere: the Visa/Mastercard supplier hack (criminal gang, mostly US) - one report says leaked files list some Australians, but no card numbers. To do: ignore any 'card security' text or call; check only in your bank's own app.
